hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: Each member A_i is obtained by applying its divided-difference operator O_i to the latent function F: A_i = O_i[F]; for G0001 O is the first divided difference f[x,y]; for G0002 O is the derivative f'(x); for G0003 O is the second divided difference with repeated node f[x,x,y].
required_assumptions: x != y for divided differences with distinct nodes
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: The three catalog expressions are divided differences of a differentiable function f with nodes {x,y}; df(x) is the first divided difference with repeated node x, and G0003 is the second divided difference with node sequence (x,x,y).
